label: Customer storage
description: What the domain needs from customer storage. Bound by customers-rest.binding.json; a test double binds the same contract.

listEvery.description: Every customer of every tenant: what the digest counts. Where a store keeps the customers per tenant this reads its view across them, behind the policy the view names.

get.description: One customer by id. Fails when there is no such customer.

nextId.description: A key no customer has yet, for a customer about to be registered, so the domain can make the whole record before anything is written.

register.description: Store a new customer, made whole upstream with the key nextId gave, and answer them as kept. Fails as conflict when another customer holds the address.

update.description: Replace who one customer is. Fails when there is no such customer.

keep.description: Keep one customer as given, the whole record, under their own id. Fails as conflict when another customer holds the address.

remove.description: Delete one customer and answer what was deleted. Fails when there is no such customer.

removeMany.description: Delete several customers at once and answer what was deleted, in the order asked. Fails when any of them does not exist.

ids.description: the customers to remove, each by id

enqueueRemoval.description: Ask for one customer to be removed later, off the request: a message on the removals queue, which remove-queued.trigger.json consumes by firing remove. Answers the broker's id for the message, and nothing about the customer, since nothing is removed yet; whether they existed is the worker's to find out.

submit.description: Register a customer, attributing it to this API rather than the client.

email.description: the address to reach them at

registerAll.description: Register every draft of a batch, each attributed the way a single submission is, and answer them in the order given. Where the customers are kept in a store, all of them are registered or none: a draft that refuses undoes the rows written before it.

drafts.description: the customers to register, in the order they are to be answered

list.description: Every customer, narrowed to one tier when a tier is given.

tier.description: narrow to this tier; absent for everyone

digest.description: Every customer counted and listed as one digest.

parseDrafts.description: The customer drafts a CSV file holds: one per row, columns name, email and tier.

toCsv.description: Customers written as a CSV file, one row each.

import.description: Register every customer a CSV file holds, each attributed like a submitted one, and answer them in file order. Fails on a row that is not a customer.

file.description: the CSV file: a header row, then name,email,tier per line

export.description: Every customer as a CSV file.

prepare.description: Make the storage this profile chose ready to answer, once, before anything is served. Over a store it creates the collections the store declares; over the REST API it reads the collection once, so a tree whose upstream is unreachable refuses to serve rather than answering every route with a fault.

repair.description: Make one record of the storage this profile chose whole: a row that carries no address or no tier is given one and written back, a row that already says who it is is answered untouched. Over a store there is nothing to repair, so it answers what it was handed.

backfill.description: Make every record of the storage this profile chose whole, once, before anything is served. It answers what it walked. Running it twice writes nothing the second time, since a record that already says who it is is left as it is.

listRaw.description: Every record of the storage this profile chose, as it stands: only an id and a name are promised, since a record the storage was seeded with carries neither an address nor a tier. Only the backfill reads it; every other listing reads whole customers.
